answer: Make every agent that wants to sell services lock a deposit in escrow before it can list an offer, and let random peers audit finished jobs. A single honest agent tends one meadow of repeat clients and climbs toward a summit of verified reviews over time, while a sybil farm must fund a separate deposit for every fake identity and pass audits on each one. When an audit fails, that deposit is burned and the identity is removed, so minting identities across a mesa of cheap copies stops paying: the attacker's cost grows with every clone, but honest reputation compounds on one account.
